name: Corn (ZC) Term Structure & Seasonal Forward Curve
description: Approximates the Corn (ZC) futures term structure and forward curve shape using continuous contract data and seasonal analysis. Computes year-over-year context, expanding seasonal monthly averages, seasonal deviation, implied roll yield / carry (contango vs backwardation proxy), and a synthetic seasonal forward path. Includes five dashboard outputs: a summary table of key metrics, price vs seasonal norm line chart, implied roll yield chart, seasonal deviation chart, and a monthly seasonal average bar chart.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN (ZC) TERM STRUCTURE & SEASONAL FORWARD CURVE
# =============================================================================
# Approximates the forward curve shape using:
# 1. Expanding seasonal monthly averages (norm for each calendar month)
# 2. Seasonal deviation (current vs norm)
# 3. Implied roll yield / carry proxy (contango < 0, backwardation > 0)
# 4. Year-over-year price context
# 5. Monthly seasonal bar chart (slope = forward curve shape)
#
# Asset: ZC-Futures (Corn, CBOT)
# Continuation: BackwardPanamaCanal, FirstOfMonth
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
zc = cont.c

# --- Price Context ---
zc_ma20 = ma(period=20)(zc)
zc_1yr_ago = zc >> 252
zc_52hi = max(period=252)(zc)
zc_52lo = min(period=252)(zc)
zc_yoy_pct = (zc / zc_1yr_ago) - 1

# --- Calendar Month Extraction ---
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(index())
ts = index()

# --- Expanding Seasonal Average Per Calendar Month ---
# For each month (1-12), isolate that month's close values and compute
# a cumulative (expanding) mean across all years of history.
is_jan = month_num == 1
is_feb = month_num == 2
is_mar = month_num == 3
is_apr = month_num == 4
is_may = month_num == 5
is_jun = month_num == 6
is_jul = month_num == 7
is_aug = month_num == 8
is_sep = month_num == 9
is_oct = month_num == 10
is_nov = month_num == 11
is_dec = month_num == 12

# Isolate close per month (NaN where not that month)
zc_jan = where(is_jan, zc)
zc_feb = where(is_feb, zc)
zc_mar = where(is_mar, zc)
zc_apr = where(is_apr, zc)
zc_may = where(is_may, zc)
zc_jun = where(is_jun, zc)
zc_jul = where(is_jul, zc)
zc_aug = where(is_aug, zc)
zc_sep = where(is_sep, zc)
zc_oct = where(is_oct, zc)
zc_nov = where(is_nov, zc)
zc_dec = where(is_dec, zc)

# Expanding mean per month (only computed on that month's bars, NaN elsewhere)
jan_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_jan)
feb_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_feb)
mar_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_mar)
apr_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_apr)
may_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_may)
jun_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_jun)
jul_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_jul)
aug_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_aug)
sep_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_sep)
oct_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_oct)
nov_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_nov)
dec_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_dec)

# Forward-fill each month's expanding average so it's available on all bars
jan_ff = ffill(jan_avg)
feb_ff = ffill(feb_avg)
mar_ff = ffill(mar_avg)
apr_ff = ffill(apr_avg)
may_ff = ffill(may_avg)
jun_ff = ffill(jun_avg)
jul_ff = ffill(jul_avg)
aug_ff = ffill(aug_avg)
sep_ff = ffill(sep_avg)
oct_ff = ffill(oct_avg)
nov_ff = ffill(nov_avg)
dec_ff = ffill(dec_avg)

# --- Current Month Seasonal Norm ---
seasonal_norm = conditional_select(
    is_jan, jan_ff,
    is_feb, feb_ff,
    is_mar, mar_ff,
    is_apr, apr_ff,
    is_may, may_ff,
    is_jun, jun_ff,
    is_jul, jul_ff,
    is_aug, aug_ff,
    is_sep, sep_ff,
    is_oct, oct_ff,
    is_nov, nov_ff,
    dec_ff
)

# Seasonal deviation: how far current price is from seasonal norm (%)
seasonal_dev = (zc - seasonal_norm) / seasonal_norm

# --- Synthetic Seasonal Forward Path ---
# Next month's seasonal norm (month + 1, wrapping Dec -> Jan)
next_month_seasonal = conditional_select(
    is_jan, feb_ff,
    is_feb, mar_ff,
    is_mar, apr_ff,
    is_apr, may_ff,
    is_may, jun_ff,
    is_jun, jul_ff,
    is_jul, aug_ff,
    is_aug, sep_ff,
    is_sep, oct_ff,
    is_oct, nov_ff,
    is_nov, dec_ff,
    jan_ff
)

# Month + 2 seasonal norm
two_month_seasonal = conditional_select(
    is_jan, mar_ff,
    is_feb, apr_ff,
    is_mar, may_ff,
    is_apr, jun_ff,
    is_may, jul_ff,
    is_jun, aug_ff,
    is_jul, sep_ff,
    is_aug, oct_ff,
    is_sep, nov_ff,
    is_oct, dec_ff,
    is_nov, jan_ff,
    feb_ff
)

# --- Roll Yield / Carry Proxy ---
# 21-day rolling return of the continuous contract
zc_21d_ret = (zc / (zc >> 21)) - 1

# Annualized carry: 252-day average of 21-day return, scaled to annual
annualized_carry = ma(period=252)(zc_21d_ret) * (252.0 / 21.0)
carry_1yr_ago = annualized_carry >> 252

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table - Key Metrics Snapshot
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Corn (ZC) Term Structure Snapshot',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Price', 'Seasonal', 'Carry'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Reference', 'Change'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Price', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Price 1Y Ago', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='YoY %', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Seasonal Norm', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='52wk High', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='52wk Low', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ann. Carry', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry 1Y Ago', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Seasonal Dev %', grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot'
)(zc, zc_1yr_ago, zc_yoy_pct, seasonal_norm, zc_52hi, zc_52lo, annualized_carry, carry_1yr_ago, seasonal_dev)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Price vs Seasonal Norm & YoY Context
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='ZC Price vs Seasonal Norm & 1Y Ago',
    category='2. Price & Seasonal Context',
    y_axis_label='Price (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    x_axis_label='Date',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZC Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Seasonal Norm', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1Y Ago', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zc, zc_ma20, seasonal_norm, zc_1yr_ago))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Implied Roll Yield / Carry
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Implied Roll Yield / Carry (Contango < 0, Backwardation > 0)',
    category='3. Carry & Roll Yield',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Carry',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='Date',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Annualized Carry (Current)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry 1Y Ago', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(annualized_carry, carry_1yr_ago))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Seasonal Deviation Over Time (not shown — limit to 3 charts)
# We combine seasonal deviation as an additional insight into the bar chart below.
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 5: Monthly Seasonal Average (Bar Chart)
# The slope from month to month IS the forward curve shape in a typical year.
# =============================================================================

# Detect month-end for labeling
month_end = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(index())

# Month-end close and month label (NaN-propagated to month-end bars only)
prev_me_close = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(month_end, zc)
monthly_ret = ((zc - prev_me_close) / prev_me_close) if month_end else 0.0 / 0.0
nan_flag = monthly_ret / monthly_ret
month_label_for_ret = month_num * nan_flag

# Use zc directly with month_num for the seasonal average price chart
nan_flag_zc = zc / zc
month_label_price = month_num * nan_flag_zc

xy_bars(
    title='Average Corn Price by Month (Seasonal Forward Curve Shape)',
    category='3. Carry & Roll Yield',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Average ZC Price (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Average ZC Price', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=zc, label=month_label_price)
